title: biosig-zarr format version 2: level-0 array metadata document
description: The zarr.json of the level-0 array (the full-resolution signal) of a channel group in a format version 2 store, transcribed from spec/index.md at release 2.0.0, which is the definition. Rules that relate two values, such as the shape and the channel count, are not expressed. Attributes the text lists as possibly absent in a version 2 store are not required, and unknown attributes are allowed.
$comment: Level-0 array: each channel group MUST contain an array named 0, written as that section states.

zarr_format.$comment: Zarr requirements: a store MUST NOT use Zarr version 2 metadata.

node_type.$comment: Level-0 array: level 0 is an array.

data_type.$comment: Level-0 array: the array MUST be int16 or float32.

shape.$comment: Level-0 array: the array MUST have shape [n_channels, n_samples].

codecs.$comment: Level-0 array: the array MUST use the sharding_indexed codec.

name.$comment: Level-0 array: the array MUST use the sharding_indexed codec.

configuration.$comment: Level-0 array: the inner codec chain and the shard index codecs.

codecs.$comment: Level-0 array: the inner chain MUST be bytes with little-endian byte order, then blosc with the zstd compressor.

index_codecs.$comment: Level-0 array: the index codecs MUST be bytes with little-endian byte order, then crc32c.

bytesLittle.$comment: Level-0 array: bytes with little-endian byte order.

bloscZstd.$comment: Level-0 array: blosc with the zstd compressor.

crc32c.$comment: Level-0 array: the crc32c index codec.

name.$comment: Level-0 array: the crc32c index codec.

attributes.$comment: Level-0 array: the REQUIRED rows of the level-0 attribute table, less source_rate_hz, chunk_samples and shard_samples, which What changes the version lists as possibly absent.

scale.description: Level-0 array: one finite, nonzero factor per channel, indexed by row_index.

items.$comment: Level-0 array: one finite, nonzero factor per channel.
